responses.global_local: Globally, bureau_score and dti were the strongest features: their mean absolute SHAP values were 0.9042 and 0.5437. Locally, for request TR-009585, bureau_score (+2.27), dti (+1.20), and loan_amount_sar (+0.20) were the main positive contributions.
responses.output_units: SHAP values are contributions to raw log-odds, not probability points. For TR-009585, the raw score was 0.9031 while the calibrated probability was 0.4795, so the raw score should not be interpreted directly as a 90.31% default probability.
responses.reason_limits: The reason statements describe model contributions, not causal reasons for default. Correlated features can share signal, so feature importance should not be interpreted as independent causal effects.
responses.calibration_evidence: On 1,733 evaluation requests, sigmoid calibration improved Brier score from 0.1130 to 0.0671 and ECE from 0.1469 to 0.0225. ROC-AUC remained 0.7708 and Average Precision remained 0.2587.
responses.stability: Calibration improved Brier score in both 2024Q3 and 2024Q4. The customer-cluster bootstrap 95% interval for Brier change was -0.0542 to -0.0374, which remained below zero. This supports improvement for the observed evaluation period but does not guarantee future performance.
responses.review_capacity: The transported calibrated threshold was 0.1733. Risk flags were within the 12% capacity in 2024Q3 (97 flags versus capacity 100), but exceeded it in 2024Q4 (109 versus 107). Including near-threshold review cases increased candidate review to 109 and 122, exceeding capacity in both periods, so capacity review is required without retuning on evaluation data.
